child.simple_meaning_en: Little friend, here is the simple wisdom of this Kural: Those who always thirst after drink will neither inspire fear (in others) nor retain the light (of their fame).

By working together at the right moment with honesty and effort, the group finished their project cleanly. Everyone learned that smart planning and true friendship overcome tough challenges.
